request.query: eventually predicate in right neighborhood exists point in positive interval

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_gt",
      "informal_name": "Existence of a Greater Element in Neighborhood Filter",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)).NeBot]\n  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b > a, p b",
      "informal_description": "In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter of a point $ a $, and the filter of neighborhoods strictly greater than $ a $ is non-trivial (i.e., not the bottom filter), then there exists an element $ b > a $ such that $ p(b) $ holds.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.LeftRight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "frequently_gt_nhds",
      "informal_name": "Frequently Greater Than in Neighborhoods",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] (a : α) [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)).NeBot],\n  ∃ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, a < x",
      "informal_description": "For a point $a$ in a topological space, if the filter of neighborhoods of $a$ intersected with the set $\\{x \\mid a < x\\}$ is non-bot, then there exist frequently points $x$ in the neighborhood of $a$ such that $a < x$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.LeftRight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_lt",
      "informal_name": "Existence of Left Neighborhood Element for Eventually True Property",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] {a : α} [(nhdsWithin a (Set.Iio a)).NeBot]\n  {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ b < a, p b",
      "informal_description": "In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exists an element $ b < a $ such that $ p(b) $ is true.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.LeftRight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "eventually_gt_nhds",
      "informal_name": "Eventually Greater Than in Neighborhood Filter",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {a b : α},\n  b < a → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, b < x",
      "informal_description": "If $ b < a $, then in the neighborhood filter at $ a $, the inequality $ b < x $ eventually holds, i.e., there exists an open neighborhood of $ a $ such that all $ x $ in this neighborhood satisfy $ b < x $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "eventually_lt_nhds",
      "informal_name": "Eventual Inequality in Neighborhood Filter",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {a b : α},\n  a < b → ∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, x < b",
      "informal_description": "If $a < b$, then eventually $x < b$ in the neighborhood of $a$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Filter.Eventually.exists_Ioo_subset",
      "informal_name": "Existence of Open Interval for Eventually Property in Neighborhood",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α]\n  {a : α} {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ {x | p x}",
      "informal_description": "In a linearly ordered topological space without maximum or minimum elements, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exist elements $ l $ and $ u $ such that $ a $ lies in the open interval $ (l, u) $ and the entire interval is contained within the set $ \\{x \\mid p(x)\\} $. This asserts that eventual truth in a neighborhood implies containment in an open interval.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Topology.Order.Basic"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_description: In a topological space equipped with a preorder, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood filter of a point $ a $, and the filter of neighborhoods strictly greater than $ a $ is non-trivial (i.e., not the bottom filter), then there exists an element $ b > a $ such that $ p(b) $ holds.

items.informal_name: Existence of Open Interval for Eventually Property in Neighborhood
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α]
  {a : α} {p : α → Prop}, (∀ᶠ (x : α) in nhds a, p x) → ∃ l u, a ∈ Set.Ioo l u ∧ Set.Ioo l u ⊆ {x | p x}
items.informal_description: In a linearly ordered topological space without maximum or minimum elements, if a property $ p $ holds eventually in the neighborhood of a point $ a $, then there exist elements $ l $ and $ u $ such that $ a $ lies in the open interval $ (l, u) $ and the entire interval is contained within the set $ \{x \mid p(x)\} $. This asserts that eventual truth in a neighborhood implies containment in an open interval.
